description:
Resolve the final documentation review findings concerning inactive configuration controls, repo-local type examples, gate execution scope, Web UI deployment, data initialization, native data-directory defaults, and coordination recovery guidance.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Configuration and example snippets distinguish shipped behavior from this repositorys local configuration and do not present inert settings as active controls.
- [hard] REQ-02: Scope, deployment, and troubleshooting instructions match the current server, Docker, worktree, and recovery implementations.
- [hard] REQ-03: No changed instruction requires an undocumented environment, proxy, or initialization step.
- [hard] REQ-04: Scoped mechanical documentation checks and repository validation pass.
title: Correct configuration, release, and deployment documentation semantics
